name: About Time Bathhouse
summary: Magnesium bathhouse in Torquay with indoor and outdoor pools, two saunas, steam and salt therapy, cold plunges, and outdoor fire pits.
cost: From $49 for 45 min, from $69 for 90 min; multi-pass packs available; weekend and public holiday rates apply

temperatures.sauna_display: Rock sauna 99°C, wood fire sauna 85°C, steam room 45°C

name: Alba Thermal Springs and Spa
summary: Geothermal springs from a 500m aquifer on the Mornington Peninsula, with indoor, open-air, and outdoor pools, spa treatments, and on-site dining.

name: Artesian Mud Baths Eulo
summary: Natural artesian mud baths in outback Queensland — mineral-rich clay, individual tubs, nibbles included, open daily from 6:30 AM.

name: AUN Bathhouse
summary: A Japanese communal bathing venue opening August 2026 on Abbotsford St, North Melbourne. Details still to come.

name: Aurora Spa & Bathhouse
summary: Subterranean magnesium bathhouse on the Mornington Peninsula with an 11-step thermal circuit, cold plunge, glacial ice room, and full treatment menu.
cost: 5-session pack $440, 10-session pack $825 (valid 1 year). Treatments from $190.

name: Bitter Springs
summary: Natural thermal spring pools in Elsey National Park, 2 km from Mataranka. Entry via NT Parks Visitor Pass. Closed November to May.
hours: Open dry season only (June to October). Closed November to May due to wet-season flooding.
cost: NT Parks Visitor Pass required. Adult: $10 (1-day), $20 (3-day), $30 (2-week), $45 (1-month), $60 (annual). Child 5–17: $5 (1-day), $10 (3-day), $15 (2-week), $22 (1-month), $30 (annual). Family (2 adults, 4 children): $25 (1-day), $50 (3-day), $75 (2-week), $110 (1-month), $150 (annual). NT residents enter free.

name: Boomi Artesian Bath
summary: A three-pool artesian complex in far northwest NSW, drawing water from 1,222 metres depth. Hot spa pool, lap pool, and wading pool; $6 entry.
cost: from $6

name: Burren Junction Artesian Bore Baths
summary: Free artesian bore bath at 36°C in the NSW outback, open around the clock with camping, showers, and BBQs on site.
hours: Open 24 hours most days; Wednesday 12:00–9:00 AM, then 1:00–11:59 PM. May close seasonally — was shut for works, reopening April 2026.

name: Chuan Spa
summary: Hotel spa on Level 9 of the Langham Melbourne, with an indoor pool overlooking the skyline, sauna, steam room, and Traditional Chinese Medicine treatments.
cost: Weekend treatments carry a $20 surcharge; Brilliant Weekday Retreat from $175 per 60-minute treatment (Mon–Fri, Langham members)
access: Facilities are complimentary for guests who book a treatment. Hotel guests may also access the pool and facilities directly, contact the spa via (03) 8696 8111 to arrange.

name: City Cave Braybrook
summary: Float therapy and infrared sauna studio in a retail strip on Ballarat Rd, with massage and red light therapy add-ons.
cost: Float Therapy $89 casual; Infrared Sauna $49 casual; packages from $129

name: Crown Spa Melbourne
summary: A large-scale hotel spa on Level 3 of Crown Towers, offering treatment rooms, one of the country's largest indoor pools, and a fully equipped gymnasium.

name: Cunnamulla Hot Springs
summary: Artesian geothermal pools beside the Warrego River in outback Queensland with sauna, steam room, cold plunge, and an open sky at night.
cost: General admission price undocumented — Body Clay Ritual clay available for purchase at $20 (subject to stock)

name: Deep Blue Hotel & Hot Springs
summary: Open-air geothermal mineral pools by the Warrnambool coast, with an indoor bathhouse, sensory caves, salt therapy, and packages tied to the adjoining hotel.
hours: Sessions at 9:30am, 12pm, 2:30pm daily; twilight session 7:30–9:30pm (16+ only)
cost: Day sessions from $55pp (Breakfast & Bathe); overnight packages from $449

name: Hale Gym & Day Spa
summary: Scandi-inspired spa in Barton with a cave plunge pool, segregated saunas and steam rooms, and nine treatment rooms. Bathing access comes with packages.

name: Hello Sauna
summary: Seasonal wood-fired sauna on the Point Lonsdale foreshore, steps from the water. Solo and group sessions, weekends and some weekday afternoons.

name: Hepburn Bathhouse & Spa
summary: Mineral-spring bathhouse operating since 1895 in Hepburn Springs, with spring-fed pools, dry sauna, and contrast thermal ritual.

name: Hot Springs Pools & Units
summary: Artesian thermal pools in Moree's spa capital — four pools from 34–39°C plus a warmed lap pool, with motel rooms right on site.

name: Lake House
summary: Lakeside hotel in Daylesford with a hot mineral soak, spa services, and a two-hat restaurant overlooking Lake Daylesford.
cost: Winter Cocoon Package from $1,000 per person twin share; $200 spa credit per room included in packages
access: Hotel guests; spa services can be booked as part of a stay package.

name: Merse Wellness Osborne Park
summary: Contrast therapy bathhouse in Osborne Park with three hot spa pools, two cold plunge pools, infrared and traditional saunas, and recovery facilities.

name: Metung Hot Springs
summary: Geothermal springs drawn from 500m below East Gippsland, spread across three bathing precincts overlooking the Gippsland Lakes.
hours: Daily 9am–6pm, open every day of the year including public holidays
cost: Towel hire $6, robe hire $15, locker hire $10. 10% surcharge on public holidays.

name: Mineral Springs Hotel
summary: A 1935 Art Deco hotel in Hepburn Springs with a mineral spa, saunas, steam room, and treatments across five dual therapy rooms.

name: Peninsula Hot Springs
summary: Geothermal mineral springs on natural grounds south of Melbourne, with separate family and adults-only bathing areas, treatments, glamping, and dining.
hours: Mon–Thu 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM; Fri 7:00 AM – 2:00 AM; Sat 5:00 AM – 2:00 AM; Sun 5:00 AM – 11:00 PM

name: Nova Holistic Spa
summary: Compact Hobart bathhouse with a magnesium spa, infrared sauna, ice bath, and an unusually broad treatment menu including Tasmania's only mHBOT pod.

name: Onsen Sauna, Contrast & Recovery Lounge
summary: A compact recovery lounge on Henley Beach Rd running contrast therapy, traditional sauna to 95°C, and mineral baths in 25-minute sessions.
cost: Contrast baths 25 min $44; traditional or infrared sauna 25 min $27; 10-pack $190; memberships from $49/week

name: Peninsula Sauna & Spa
summary: Nude sauna venue in Seaford operating since the early 1990s, with regular themed events and a regular clientele.
hours: Mon, Wed, Thu: 12:00pm–10:30pm; Tue, Fri, Sat: 12:00pm–6:30pm; Sun: 12:00pm–8:00pm
cost: From $25 (Xposed Nude Sunday)

name: Pilliga Artesian Bore Bath
summary: A 37°C artesian bore bath in outback NSW, open 24 hours, with basic camping on-site. Simple, remote, and genuinely old.
cost: $7.50 per night camping fee; maximum stay 4 nights

name: Pond Bathhouse
summary: Magnesium mineral pools, infrared saunas, a steam room, and an ice bath in Mornington, with a cap of 20 guests at a time.
hours: Mon 9am–9pm, Tue 8am–8pm, Wed 7:30am–8pm, Thu 10am–9pm, Fri 8:30am–9pm, Sat 7:30am–6pm, Sun 9am–6pm
cost: Treatments from $175 (60-min massage); Total Reset Package from $195 (120 mins: bathhouse + massage)

name: Woodlands Rainforest Retreat
summary: Adults-only mountain resort near Narbethong with private mineral pools, an indoor Roman bathhouse, and couples spa packages.
cost: From $615 per person for the 80-minute bathing, 80-minute couples massage & Japanese Charcoal BBQ package

name: Sóma Bathhouse
summary: Small, community-focused bathhouse in Essendon with a magnesium hot spa, infrared sauna, and cold plunge, communal or private bathing available.
silence_policy: Zen Zone sessions (Tue mornings, Thu afternoons, Sun afternoons) run silent, no talking allowed.

name: Sauna Goose
summary: Wood-fired sauna in a Northcote yard, running structured three-round sessions with an optional Saunagus guided ritual. $25 standard, $35 guided.
cost: Standard session $25, Saunagus (guided) $35. Intro offer: 5 unguided sessions for $50 (valid 2 weeks). 5-pack Sauna $100, 10-pack Sauna $200.

name: Savoy Day Spa
summary: Underground communal bathhouse in downtown Hobart, Tasmania's only one, with magnesium pool, spas, sauna, and steam room from $40 drop-in.
cost: $40 per person (drop-in, no booking required for bathhouse)

name: Sense of Self (SOS)
summary: Collingwood bathhouse with magnesium pool, steam room, cold plunge and sauna, plus massage treatments and a retail shelf.
cost: Vouchers available for bathing, treatments and products

name: Shizuka Ryokan Japanese Wellness Retreat & Bathhouse
summary: A six-room Japanese inn on four acres of Hepburn bushland, with spa treatments, mineral bathing, and an on-site restaurant.

name: Soak Bathhouse – South Yarra
summary: Modern urban bathhouse in South Yarra with magnesium mineral pools, dry cedarwood sauna, steam room, cold plunge, and add-on treatments.
cost: Early Bird from $39 (weekday) / $49 (Fri–Sun); standard Soak from $59 (weekday) / $69 (Fri–Sun); Soak Essentials (90 min) from $89 (weekday) / $99 (Fri–Sun)

name: Stillwater Saunas
summary: A floating Scandinavian-style sauna on Lake Sambell in Beechworth, with a stone stove, löyly steam, and a natural lake plunge.
cost: Shared Pass (up to 4 other guests) or Private Pass (up to 5 guests total); multi-pass and gift vouchers available. Pricing amounts not published.

name: Subway Sauna
summary: A 24-hour gay men's sauna in a vault under Flinders Street — 30 serviced rooms, two cruise areas, a cafe and bar.

name: The Mineral Spa
summary: Natural mineral spa in Hepburn Springs with bathing pools, sauna, steam room, and treatment menu. Ages 16 and over.
cost: 90-minute Retreat Pass available; spa treatment packages from 90 minutes

name: Waldheim Alpine Spa
summary: Treatment spa at Cradle Mountain Lodge with a private Sanctuary circuit of hot tub, cool plunge, sauna and steam room among King Billy pines.
access: Part of Cradle Mountain Lodge, day spa visitors can book treatments or the Sanctuary session without being a lodge guest.

name: My Recovery Lounge
summary: Recovery-focused bathhouse on Bay St with a hot magnesium bath, traditional and infrared saunas, and 2–9 degree ice baths, in private or semi-private sessions.
cost: Members save 15% across all services; unlimited sauna/ice bath/infrared/compression boots memberships available at multiple price points
